headline: FirstEnergy to Report Q2 Earnings: What's in Store for the Stock?
summary: FE's Q2 revenues are likely to have risen 6.28% as load growth and grid investments offset higher costs, while EPS might have slipped 5.77%.

headline: Goldman lifts data center capacity outlook, flags utility stocks set to benefit
summary: Investing.com -- Global data center capacity is set to expand far faster than previously expected over the rest of the decade, driven by surging AI infrastructure demand, but supply is still likely to remain tight as hyperscalers and emerging cloud providers race to secure computing power.
